title: Best Practices Quiz
description: Test your knowledge of effective prompting, privacy, security, and limitations.

questions.text: Writing descriptive comments before your code helps GitHub Copilot generate more accurate suggestions.
GitHub Copilot can browse the internet in real time to fetch up-to-date documentation.
Opening related files (interfaces, utilities, examples) in your editor gives Copilot more context for better suggestions.
Which of the following is a known limitation of GitHub Copilot?

options.text: It only works with JavaScript and TypeScript
Its training data has a cutoff date, so it may suggest deprecated APIs
It requires a minimum of 100 lines of code before generating suggestions
It can only produce single-line completions

questions.text: What is the recommended best practice when using GitHub Copilot for security-critical code?

options.text: Accept all suggestions without review since AI accuracy is very high
Never use Copilot for any backend code
Always review, test, and fully understand every suggestion before accepting it
Only use Copilot for frontend UI code
